confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from four web searches. Sources were Numbeo-derived Faro figures, other cost-of-living aggregators and Expatistan. Inexpensive meal (about €12), cappuccino (about €1.70-2.00), draft beer (about €3.00-3.13) and mid-range dinner for two (about €38) are fairly consistent across those sources. I raised them modestly for July peak-season pricing and converted euros to USD at about 1.16 USD/EUR, which is my own assumption, not a searched rate. Cocktail is based on a thin Expatistan figure (about €8, 8 data points, flagged as not yet reliable) and a general restaurant-bar premium over beer. Wine by the glass is an estimate from the local beer relationship plus a Portuguese glass range of €3-6 seen for nearby Albufeira. I found no direct glass price for Faro. All five accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July Algarve demand, with no booking pages or listings inspected, so they are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Faro price levels are lower than Lisbon and Porto-area tourist cores, and close to other Algarve towns such as Tavira and Lagos. They are somewhat below Albufeira and Vilamoura resort pricing. Accommodation is scaled for July peak season at an Algarve gateway city.
